name: BigMoeOnEdge
description: Run MoE models bigger than your RAM. Frontier-size MoE on a phone, laptop, edge. Lossless, on stock llama.cpp. An adaptive streaming optimizer. Any hardware, any OS, any model, any quantization, behind a local OpenAI-compatible server.
